review_notes: I read the whole target file and the definitions of `history`, `velocityJet`, `knownJets` and `knownForce` in PacketProfileRecursion.lean. I grepped for every use of `knownJets` in the Euler directory. The target file has no simp lemmas or attributes of its own. The only simp interface relevant to it is the case-split API for `knownJets`, `history` and `velocityJet`. A grep of PacketProfileRecursion.lean shows no `history_*` or `velocityJet_*` equation lemmas. Its only `@[simp]` lemmas are `profiles_zero` and `profiles_one`. I did not run Lean, so the finding is about missing equation lemmas and does not claim that any simp call fails or loops. I did not check the exact shape of the `SpatialJetField.congr` goals, so I cannot say precisely which of the trailing `rfl`s the new lemmas would remove.

findings.problem: There are no equation or simp lemmas for the three branches of `history` (`i < p`, `i = p`, `i > p`), for `velocityJet` at `0` and at a nonzero index, or for `knownJets` itself. Every proof has to unfold `knownJets`, `history` and `velocityJet` with a hand-picked `simp only` set plus the case hypotheses (`hi`, `hz`, `he`, `ite_true`, `ite_false`, `↓reduceIte`). Some of these proofs then need a bare `rfl` or `change` to close the goal. Here the unfolding appears four times, at lines 41, 48, 53 and 56. The same unfolding is copied in at least these places: PacketCylinderForcingParity.lean (`PrefixOdd.knownJet_value_odd`), PacketCylinderPrefixLocality.lean (four `simpa only [knownJets,history,...]` calls), PacketProfileTailGrade.lean, PacketRecursiveCancellation.lean and PacketKnownPieces.lean. Each copy depends on the unfolded `ite` shape, and a change to the definitions would break all of them. The branch conditions also have to be re-supplied by hand every time.
findings.proposed_change: Next to `history`, `velocityJet` and `knownJets` in PacketProfileRecursion.lean, add conditional equation lemmas with the branch condition as a hypothesis. For `history`: `history p u c i = u i` when `i < p`, `history p u c i = c` when `i = p`, and `history p u c i = 0` when `p < i`. For `velocityJet`: `velocityJet s a z 0 = 0`, and `velocityJet s a z i = slicedJet s (a i).high z + slicedJet s (a i).mean z + slicedJet s (a (i-1)).corrector z` when `i ≠ 0`. For `knownJets`, state the same three cases directly, for `i < p`, `i = p` and `p < i`. Mark the hypothesis-guarded rewrites `@[simp]`, since simp can discharge them from `hi`, `hz` and `he` in context. Then the four `simp only [knownJets, history, ...]` calls in this file shrink to `simp [knownJets_of_lt, hi, hz, ...]`. Where the lemma states the result in the same form as the goal, the trailing `rfl`s may become unnecessary. The same lemmas can replace the copies in the other files.
findings.benefit: Callers state the case split once instead of unfolding three definitions and managing `ite` lemmas by hand. This removes copy-pasted unfolding scripts from at least six proofs. It also keeps the simp normal form stable if `history` or `velocityJet` is later restructured.
